items.name: SpanData
items.summary: `SpanData` contains all the information collected by a `Span` and can be used by exporters as a standard input.

items.name: SpanExporter
items.summary: `SpanExporter` defines the interface that protocol-specific exporters must implement so that they can be plugged into OpenTelemetry SDK and support sending of telemetry data.

methods.name: export
methods.signature: fn export(&self, batch: Vec<SpanData>) -> impl std::future::Future<Output = OTelSdkResult> + Send
methods.summary: Exports a batch of readable spans. Protocol exporters that will implement this function are typically expected to serialize and transmit the data to the destination.

methods.name: force_flush
methods.summary: This is a hint to ensure that the export of any Spans the exporter has received prior to the call to this function SHOULD be completed as soon as possible, preferably before returning from this method.

methods.name: set_resource
methods.summary: Set the resource for the exporter.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.summary: Shuts down the exporter with default timeout.

methods.name: shutdown_with_timeout
methods.summary: Shuts down the exporter. Called when SDK is shut down. This is an opportunity for exporter to do any cleanup required.
